items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution this cycle. Existing evidence supports reversible site improvements in SEO, performance, accessibility, and conversion, but the authoritative candidate list is empty while 46 failure follow-ups, 29 deployed improvements awaiting measurement, and unresolved security/measurement gates remain. Preserve these opportunities as deferred backlog; do not create new proposals, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, requeues, deployments, or monetization changes. Continue existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failed-work repair-or-close review, and bounded evidence work. No unsupported revenue or causal-lift claims are made.
